placeholderPolicy: Every /ROOT_ONLY_UNBOUND path is an absolute POSIX lexical placeholder, never an existing file, credential or permission claim; Root alone substitutes approved protected files. No secret value is requested or supplied.
allowedOriginDisposition: http://127.0.0.1:3100 is a proposed exact browser origin for the typed example, not an observation of the current browser. Root must preserve/bind the actual origin, including hostname/scheme/port; allowedOrigins is an Origin filter, not a cross-origin proxy or CORS enablement.
secretLoadingContract: Source reads DSNs from process environment, not *_FILE variables or DSN CLI flags. Root-owned protected-file loader must create the exact child environment privately; do not put values in argv, Docker env inspection, Git, stdout or logs. No owner/superuser/operator-admission DSN may be substituted.

apiStartup.alternativeFactory: inv.app:create_configured_app via uvicorn --factory; src/saintvision/server.py:create_app delegates to same factory. Use installed uvicorn CLI only after Root binds its exact flags/port/self-URL. Never inv.app:app (unconfigured module-level app).

workerStartup.scope: Tenant queue/containment/output reconciliation, not PC3-only or one-run-only CLI; Root must inventory/authorize affected pending work before invocation. One --once is not completion; actual receipt/output may require approved subsequent iterations.

expiresAt.constraint: now < expiresAt <= now+7*86400; actual Root-approved expiry unbound

keys.each: Actual copied PUBLIC RSA JWK; kty=RSA/alg=RS256/use=sig, unique nonempty kid<=128, RSA2048..4096; private d prohibited. PyJWT parses public n/e. Inner JWK is not source-enforced as a closed object.

rootOnlyRouteProposal.wsFlagInFixedViteSource: ABSENT; no WebSocket proxy acceptance claimed
